Monday, 28 December 2015

21
st
training course on
Molecular techniques as applied for infectious disease research
February 22-27, 2016 (Sponsored by DBT, GOI)
Department of Biochemistry & JB Tropical Disease Research Centre, MGIMS, Sevagram is going to organize 21
st
hands on short-term training course on ‘Molecular techniques as applied for infectious disease research’ during February 22-27, 2016. It is open for Faculty members / Post-graduates / PhD and research students working in medical and research institutes. Candidates should possess a qualification of M.Sc. / M. Pharm. / MD/ PhD.
This foundation course includes hands on training on basic & routine molecular biology techniques viz., Cloning, Expression and Purification of recombinant proteins, Real-Time PCR; Analytical techniques like 2D-Gel Electrophoresis, SDS-PAGE, Western Blotting; Immunological techniques that include Immunodiagnostic, immunomodulatory & cellular assays, cytokine assays; in vitro parasite culture and drug screening assays. Some of the experts working in the areas related to the theme of the course will share their experiences during the course.
The number of participants will be restricted to 15. Interested candidates can submit their brief resume by email to the Course organizer (
biochem@mgims.ac.in
. )
Last date of application: Jan. 15, 2016. For more details you can download the
course pamphlet.
Course Organizer:
Dr. MVR Reddy Director-Prof. & Head
Dept. of Biochemistry
MGIMS, Sevagram
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
